A steady detector level of 0 dB is 10 dB above Threshold; compression retains 2 dB of that excess, giving -8 dB. A level of -12 dB is below Threshold and is not attenuated.
示例采用内部检测，Input、Makeup、Output Gain 均为 0 d: This example uses internal detection, 0 dB Input, Makeup and Output Gain, and Mix=100%. The formula describes a steady detector level, not a hard limit on individual samples. For changing signals and the Display, see pages 16-17.

Classic 与 Super 都支持向上压缩。将 Ratio 调到 1:1 以: Classic and Super both support upward compression. Set Ratio below 1:1 to lift audio above Threshold. Their gain curves differ, but both use Threshold and Range to select the audio to process; see pages 8-9.
普通模式与 Limiter 均按算法确定阈值下限：Classic 最低 -90: Normal and Limiter use the same algorithm limits: Classic reaches -90 dB and Super retains -inf. Scale changes the visible range only; see page 16. New normal-mode instances remember the last manually selected algorithm; projects and A/B recall saved choices. Limiter settings are separate. Short fades reduce switching transients.
阈值以上按固定 dB 比例压缩。下压时，超出阈值的 dB 数除以 Ratio，决: A fixed dB ratio above the threshold. For downward compression, divide the excess dB by Ratio to find how much excess remains.
使用原有 QQ 曲线。Ratio 决定曲线力度，但不表示每一个电平位置都具有固定: The original QQ curve. Ratio sets its strength, but does not describe a fixed dB compression ratio at every detector level.
它们都能影响结果，但不能互相精确替代。: Three useful controls, not interchangeable settings.
普通压缩的单压以 1:1 为中点：高于 1:1 时向下压缩，低于 1:1 时向上: Normal Single processing is neutral at 1:1: above it, processing is downward; below it, processing is upward. Within the active threshold range, higher downward ratios usually cut more, while smaller upward ratios usually boost more. Dual separates UP RATIO and DOWN RATIO; see page 10.
Classic 与 Super 的 Ratio 含义见第 6 页。普通单压范围为: See page 6 for the meaning of Ratio in Classic and Super. Normal Single mode ranges from 1:200 to 200:1, with 1:1 as the default. Final peak protection comes from the Limiter Ceiling; increasing the normal compression Ratio alone does not enable Limiter.
Input Gain 调整进入处理路径的电平，也会改变 Dry 路径的音量。使用: Input Gain changes the level entering the processing path, including the Dry path. With INT it also changes the detector level relative to Threshold. With EXT, the external send and Key Gain set the detector level; Input Gain is not a substitute.
Mix 在 Dry 和处理后的 Wet 之间混合。它不只是一个附加效果比例，也是: Mix blends Dry with processed Wet. It is also a useful processing amount control: first make the boost or cut clear, then lower Mix to blend back the original dynamics you want to retain.
Mix = 0% 时有效动态增益为 0 dB；100% 时保留完整处理量。中间值: At Mix = 0%, effective dynamic gain is 0 dB; at 100%, the full processing amount is retained. Intermediate values are not simply the gain in dB multiplied by Mix. Makeup and Output Gain are excluded from this dynamic gain.
实用顺序：先调 Ratio 找到处理感，再用 Mix 控制最终力度；需要改变整体: A practical order: find the compression character with Ratio, set its final strength with Mix, adjust Input Gain when you need a different input level, then compare loudness again.
先决定哪些声音要处理，再调整处理的力度。: Choose which levels to process, then set the amount.
Threshold：超过阈值才开始压缩: Threshold: compression starts above this level
Threshold 决定从多大的声音开始处理。低于或等于它的部分不进行压缩；超过: Threshold sets the level at which processing begins. Audio at or below it receives no compression. Above it, Ratio determines how much to attenuate or lift.
Range：超过它的部分不进行压缩: Range: compression stops at this level
Range 让较响的部分保留原来的动态。达到或超过 Range 时，不再向下压低: Range preserves the dynamics of louder audio. At or above Range, neither attenuation nor upward gain is applied. Compression therefore acts only between Threshold and Range. In normal Single mode, the Range fader is above Threshold.
例如 Threshold = -30 dB、Range = -10 dB：: For example, set Threshold to -30 dB and Range to -10 dB:
调低 Range，会让更多较响的部分不参与压缩；调高 Range，则允许更响的部: Lower Range to exclude more loud audio from compression; raise it to include louder audio. Keep Threshold fixed first, then move Range and listen for the parts that regain their original dynamics.
Range OFF：关闭 Range 的作用: Range OFF: disable the Range control
把 Range 推到顶部 OFF，Range 推子就不再限制哪些较响的声音要停止: Move Range to OFF at the top to stop excluding louder audio. Levels above Threshold continue to follow the selected algorithm. OFF disables Range's effect; compression itself remains active.
Range = 0 dB：达到 0 dB 就停止压缩；Range OFF：不再由:
Range = 0 dB stops compression at 0 dB. Range OFF removes this stopping level.
When Range and Threshold coincide, no processing interval remains and dynamic processing stops. The faders move together when they meet; drag back to separate them.
Processing tapers off near Range and stops at it. This transition follows signal level; it adds no Attack / Release stage.
<b>如果出现噼啪声：</b>启用 Range 后，部分素材可能出现噼啪声。可以: If you hear crackles: Range can produce crackles on some material. Try enabling SAFE for more stable detection, then compare. SAFE may also attenuate audio before and after loud events, so listen for both effects; see pages 19-20.
本页说的“不进行压缩”仅指不再压低或提升动态；Input、Makeup、Mix: Here, “no compression” means no dynamic attenuation or lift. Input, Makeup, Mix and Output Gain still apply. With EXT, the external sidechain level determines the region. Limiter does not use Range; see page 33.
按 Ratio 压低或提升。: Attenuate or lift according to Ratio.
先看压缩怎样处理，再比较补偿音量后的结果。: First understand the gain change, then compare after matching levels.
向下压缩：压低超过阈值的部分: Downward compression: attenuate audio above Threshold
在 SINGLE 中，把 Ratio 从 1:1 向右调，例如 2:1、4:1、: In SINGLE, turn Ratio right from 1:1 to values such as 2:1, 4:1 or 8:1. Audio above Threshold is attenuated, reducing the difference between loud and quiet levels. Audio at or below Threshold is not attenuated.
下压后，主体可能听起来变小。再提高 Makeup 或 Output，让主体回到便: The main sound may become quieter. Raising Makeup or Output to match its original level also raises the uncompressed audio below Threshold.
把 Ratio 从 1:1 向左调，例如 1:2、1:4、1:8，就进入向上压缩: Turn Ratio left from 1:1 to values such as 1:2, 1:4 or 1:8 for upward compression. Within the active region, quieter audio generally receives more lift than louder audio, reducing the dynamic difference. Audio at or below Threshold is not lifted.
Classic 与 Super 都支持这两种处理方式。两者的力度曲线不同，但这里: Classic and Super both support these directions. Their gain curves differ, but the threshold rules here are the same. When Range is enabled, levels at or above it are neither attenuated nor lifted; see page 8.
上压与下压的对称关系: The symmetry between upward and downward compression
在同一种算法内，把下压 8:1 与上压 1:8 的阈值以上声音匹配到相同音量，主: Within the same algorithm, level-matching audio above Threshold can make downward 8:1 and upward 1:8 produce the same result in the main processing region. Classic and Super each have this symmetry. Overall compensation also affects audio below Threshold, where the results differ; see page 15 for numbers.
想连同阈值以下的轻声一起抬高，可尝试下压后补回音量。想提升选中的细节，同时保留更: To raise quiet audio below Threshold as well, try downward compression followed by compensation. To lift selected details while retaining quieter noise, breaths or ambience, try upward compression with Threshold above the sounds you want to leave alone. Compare in the full mix.
接近 Threshold 时，上压的提升会逐渐进入；接近 Range 时，处理量: Upward gain fades in near Threshold; processing tapers off near Range. Do not expect exact equivalence around those boundaries. Changing Mix also calls for a fresh listening comparison.
启用 Range 后，达到或超过 Range: At or above an active Range
双压：较轻处提升，较响处压低: Dual: lift quieter parts, control louder ones
点击 Ratio 旁的小按钮，将 SINGLE 切换为 DUAL。: Click the small button beside Ratio to change SINGLE to DUAL.
DUAL：UP RATIO 与 DOWN RATIO 分别控制两种方向；UP /: DUAL: UP RATIO and DOWN RATIO control the two directions separately. UP / DOWN thresholds replace Threshold / Range.
达到 DOWN 阈值时，动态增益回到 0 dB；超过后停止上压，只由 Down: At DOWN, dynamic gain returns to 0 dB. Above it, upward processing stops and only Down Ratio applies. The two gains never stack at the same detector level. Dual has no Range control.
DOWN 必须在 UP 上方或与其重合。拖动相撞会推着另一根一起移动；两阈值重合: DOWN must stay at or above UP. When one fader reaches the other, it pushes the other along. Dynamic processing stops when the thresholds coincide.
普通 UP：Classic 为 -90 dB，Super 为 -inf。DOWN: Normal UP: -90 dB in Classic, -inf in Super. DOWN: 0 dB.
低阈值与高阈值从两端开始；不是关闭上压。: The thresholds start at opposite ends; this does not disable upward processing.
上压与下压都不改变动态；调整 Ratio 后才能听到效果。: Neither direction changes dynamics until Ratio is adjusted.
UP / DOWN 分别有开关和算法按钮，可独立试听与选择曲线。: UP / DOWN each have an on/off switch and an algorithm button for separate auditioning and curve selection.
两路开启；上、下算法分别显示在对应 Ratio 区。开关保留 Ratio 数值。: Upward and downward compression are on. Each algorithm is shown in its Ratio area. The switches preserve Ratio values.
先建立完整的 Dual 设置: Set up the full Dual sound
设好两个阈值和 Ratio，播放包含轻声与较响片段的素材。: Set both thresholds and Ratios. Play material with quiet and loud passages.
关闭 DOWN 听上压，关闭 UP 听下压，再同时开启。两路可各选 Classi: Turn DOWN off to hear upward compression, then UP off to hear downward compression, then enable both. Each direction can use Classic or Super; changing the UP algorithm does not change DOWN.
看显示，再做等响度比较: Check the display and compare at similar loudness
开关会改变对应的动态增益与 Display 历史参考。最后补偿整体音量，比较细节: The switches update dynamic gain and the Display history reference. Compensate overall level, then compare detail, articulation and consistency.
开关只影响对应的上压或下压: Each switch affects only its own compression direction
每一路 ON / OFF 使用短交叉淡变，减少切换瞬态。关闭某一路不会移动阈值，: Each ON / OFF switch uses a short crossfade to reduce transients. Disabling one direction does not move thresholds or extend the other into its region. Normal LR / MS allows separate channel switches. With Mode LINK enabled, corresponding UP switches follow each other, as do DOWN switches; UP and DOWN remain independent.
UP 与 DOWN 之间提升，超过 DOWN 后压低。: Boost between UP and DOWN; attenuation above DOWN.
只保留上压；达到 DOWN 后仍停止提升。: Upward only. Boost still stops at DOWN.
只保留下压；低于 DOWN 时不作动态处理。: Downward only. No dynamic processing below DOWN.
不作动态提升或衰减；其余音量与 Mix 设置仍有效。: No dynamic boost or attenuation. Other gain and Mix settings still apply.
普通压缩 DUAL 的两个 Ratio 之间显示小 LINK；Limiter 不: Normal DUAL has a small LINK between its two Ratio controls. Limiter does not.
Up 与 Down 各自保留原来的相对关系；打开 LINK 不会使数值跳变。: Up and Down retain their existing relative relationship. Enabling LINK does not make values jump.
首次使用时 Ratio LINK 默认开启。之后会记住你上次的选择；重新打开已保: Ratio LINK defaults to on at first use, then remembers your last choice. When reopening a saved project, the LINK state saved in that project takes priority.
例如 Down 加倍，Up 的数值就减半；调 Up 时也是同样的反向关系。从 4: For example, doubling Down halves the Up value; adjusting Up uses the same inverse relationship. Starting at 4:1 and 1:2 will not force them into a reciprocal pair. Dragging, fine adjustment and direct entry all follow this rule.
达到最小值或最大值时，会一起停下: Linked controls stop together at their limits
普通压缩 Up 为 1:200 至 1:1，Down 为 1:1 至 200:1: Normal compression offers Up from 1:200 to 1:1 and Down from 1:1 to 200:1. If either would exceed its range, both stop at the shared limit. Reverse the adjustment to continue. Toggling LINK alone does not change the ratios.
可直接关闭 DOWN 旁的开关，保留 Down Ratio 数值。若还要单独调整: Switch DOWN off to preserve its Ratio while auditioning Up. To adjust Up Ratio independently as well, turn off the small Ratio LINK; otherwise the Down value still follows your adjustment.
普通 LR / MS 的小 LINK 联动每个声道内部的上、下 Ratio；Mo: In normal LR / MS, the small LINK connects Up and Down ratios within each channel. Mode LINK connects channels; see page 25. Limiter UP / DOWN ratios are always independent: set downward compression first, then add a little upward compression; see page 34.
Input / Output LINK：反向补偿增益: Input / Output LINK: opposite gain changes
位于 INPUT GAIN 右上方，与 Ratio LINK 分开工作。: Above and to the right of INPUT GAIN. It is separate from Ratio LINK.
示例：Input 为 +3 dB，Output 为 -3 dB，LINK 开启。: Example: Input +3 dB, Output -3 dB, with LINK enabled.
打开 LINK 后，在界面上增加 Input Gain，Output Gain: With LINK on, raising Input Gain in the interface lowers Output Gain by the same number of dB. Adjusting Output moves Input in the opposite direction too. This helps reduce simple level changes while you explore a different level entering the processor.
它按变化量反向联动，不会强行把两个数值变成互为相反数。只开启或关闭 LINK，当: The link applies opposite gain changes; it does not force the two values to be exact opposites. Toggling LINK does not change existing gains. If either control reaches its limit, both stop together.
首次使用默认开启。之后新实例沿用你上次选择的状态；打开已保存工程时，以工程保存的: LINK is on initially. New instances then use your last choice; a saved project restores its own state. Projects and A/B save the current LINK setting. Check the link switches after recalling a snapshot before making further adjustments.
普通 Input / Output LINK 只做增益的反向调整，不能替代 Ma: Normal Input / Output LINK only applies opposite gain changes; it does not replace Match. In Limiter it is hidden and inactive. LINK beside Output connects the downward threshold and output compensation; see page 33.
Match 与 Makeup：累计播放，再做补偿: Match and Makeup: measure from playback start
播放中可点击；每次都使用本次播放开始至点击时的累计内容。: Click during playback; each click uses the entire current playback up to that point.
开始播放，建立有效数据: Start playback and establish a measurement
先选好普通压缩 / Limiter 与耳机状态，再播放有代表性的非静音素材。建立: Choose normal compression or Limiter and the headphone state first. Play representative, non-silent material. Once valid loudness data is available, you can click Match during playback.
第一次点击不清空记录。假设在第 10 秒和第 20 秒点击，分别使用开始至第 1: The first click does not clear the measurement. Clicking at 10 and 20 seconds uses the first 10 and first 20 seconds respectively. It does not add the previous compensation again.
重新播放，才开始新一段: A new playback starts a new measurement
停止后保留本次结果；下次开始播放时重新累计。播放没有停止时，循环和跳转仍属于同一: Stopping retains the result. The next playback starts a new cumulative measurement. Loops and seeks during uninterrupted playback still belong to the same Match measurement.
FULL 在关闭界面后继续统计。ECO 要做完整累计 Match，须在播放前打开: FULL continues measuring with the editor closed. In ECO, open the editor before playback and keep it open for a complete Match measurement. Missing analysis makes Match unavailable for that playback; restart playback to restore it.
固定比较条件，再判断声音: Fix the comparison conditions before judging the sound
普通压缩比较 Dry 与补偿前 Wet；Limiter 耳机模式比较原始输入与实: Normal compression compares Dry with Wet before compensation. Limiter headphone mode compares the original input with the actual limited monitoring output, then applies one shared Makeup value. Neither Match clicks nor Makeup adjustments reset the measurement start.
切换 Limiter 或耳机状态会改变测量基准并清空统计；请在开始测量前选好。完: Switching Limiter or headphone state changes the measurement reference and clears the statistics. Choose these before measuring. Silence or insufficient data cannot be matched. To compare only new settings, stop and replay the same material.
Match 补偿响度，Ceiling 控制最终峰值。完成后仍需查看输出与 TP，: Match compensates loudness; Ceiling controls final peaks. Check output and TP afterwards, and use Bypass / A/B to compare attacks, tails and dynamics.
补偿 Wet 的音量，位于 Mix 之前；普通模式 ±30 dB，Limiter: Adjusts Wet level before Mix: normal mode ±30 dB; Limiter ±120 dB.
普通压缩 ±24 dB；Limiter ±120 dB。耳机试听见第 37-38: Normal compression: ±24 dB; Limiter: ±120 dB. Headphone comparisons: pages 37-38.
点击后按累计响度写入 Makeup；不是持续自动音量。: Each click sets Makeup from cumulative loudness; this is not continuous automatic gain.
A、B 为两组声音设置；A→B 与 B→A 用来复制。: A and B hold two sound settings. A→B and B→A copy between them.
在 A 调好算法与处理量。用 A→B 将它复制到 B，再切换到 B。复制会替换目: Set the algorithm and processing amount in A. Copy A→B, then switch to B. Copying replaces the destination sound settings.
只改变想比较的部分: Change the part you want to compare
例如 A 使用 Classic，B 使用 Super；或 A 使用向下压缩，B: For example, use Classic in A and Super in B, or compare downward and upward processing. Keep Lookahead, detector source and monitoring the same where possible.
对两组设置分别播放相同素材并 Match，必要时微调 Makeup。点 A /: Play the same material for each setting and use Match; trim Makeup if needed. Click A / B and compare the sound, without mistaking louder for better.
分别在 Classic 内、Super 内比较：保持同一 Threshold、L: Compare within Classic or within Super. Use the same Threshold, Lookahead, Window and SAFE state, Range OFF, Mix 100%, and no Ceiling or other extra processing. Match levels using audio above Threshold: the main processing region can then give the same result.
例：Classic，Threshold = -24 dB。A 为下压 8:1，再: Example: Classic, Threshold = -24 dB. A uses downward 8:1 followed by +21 dB compensation. B uses upward 1:8 with no compensation. Steady-level results:
阈值以下原本都没有压缩，但 A 的整体补偿也把它抬高了，所以两者出现区别。Sup: Neither setting compresses below Threshold, but A's overall compensation raises that audio too, producing a difference. Super has the same type of symmetry with a different compensation amount. This does not mean that Super and Classic sound identical.
阈值附近的上压过渡、启用 Range、改变 Mix 或极端提升量都可能打破这种对: The upward transition near Threshold, an active Range, a different Mix or extreme boosts can break this correspondence. Match measures loudness across the whole playback, including audio below Threshold. To examine this example, align the level of the main sound above Threshold.
A/B 使用过渡处理来减少瞬态。比较时保持 Lookahead 与过采样一致，更: A/B uses transitions to reduce switching artifacts. Keep Lookahead and OS equal to focus on the sound; changing modes or rates may make the host update delay compensation. A/B recalls each saved Window value and realigns the Display accordingly.

Lookahead 与 Window：延迟和声音分开调: Lookahead and Window: separate delay from sound
保持延迟不变，连续试听不同 Lookahead 长度的声音。: Keep latency fixed while comparing the sound of shorter Lookahead lengths.
Lookahead 表示为提前预读预留多少毫秒。插件将音频延后输出，才能提前分析: Lookahead reserves time to read ahead. The plug-in delays output so it can analyze upcoming audio; this sets the base latency and the maximum Window. Window sets how far before and after the current sample the processor looks for peaks when calculating gain.
Window 就是在固定延迟下降低实际 Lookahead: Window shortens effective Lookahead at fixed latency
例如 Lookahead 26 ms / Window 10 ms，与 Look: Compare Lookahead 26 ms / Window 10 ms with Lookahead 10 ms / Window 10 ms. With other settings equal and settled, and the audio delay-aligned, core compression and harmonic coloration are the same. The first setting simply retains 16 ms more base latency. You can therefore compare shorter Lookahead sounds without repeatedly changing plug-in latency.
这里的基础延迟不含 OS 滤波和 Limiter Ceiling 的额外延迟；保: Base latency excludes OS filters and Limiter Ceiling latency. With other settings fixed, adjusting only Window leaves the reported total latency unchanged too.
为什么适合连续比较声音？: Why this helps continuous listening comparisons
直接切换 Lookahead，宿主可能重新调整延迟补偿，从而出现短暂停顿。改调: Changing Lookahead directly may make the host adjust delay compensation, causing a brief pause. Window retains the same latency, allowing continuous comparison of attacks, tails, dynamics and coloration without that compensation change.
Window 是参考时长，不是压缩间隔: Window is a detection duration, not an update interval
Window = 10 ms，不表示每隔 10 ms 才压缩一次。它表示每次计算: Window = 10 ms does not mean compression happens once every 10 ms. Each gain calculation considers peaks within 10 ms before and after the current sample; Normal / Safe then chooses between them. Detection moves and gain updates on every sample. Shortening Window changes the reference range, not the update rate.
设定基础延迟。可选 0、26、40、80、100 ms；默认 26 ms。改变它: Sets base latency: 0, 26, 40, 80 or 100 ms; default 26 ms. Changing it may require the host to update delay compensation.
在 0 至当前 Lookahead 之间调整实际检测长度。改变声音，但保持已设定: Sets actual detection length from 0 to the selected Lookahead. Changes the sound while retaining the selected latency.
Lookahead 与 Window：操作及 0 ms: Lookahead and Window: controls and 0 ms
先用 Window 选声音，再决定是否缩短 Lookahead 延迟。: Choose the sound with Window first, then decide whether to reduce Lookahead latency.
Lookahead 与 Window 位于右下控制区的同一排；Window 的单: Lookahead and Window share a row in the lower-right controls. Window always uses milliseconds.
26 ms / Window 0 ms，与 0 ms / Window 0 ms: 26 ms / Window 0 ms versus 0 ms / Window 0 ms
在相同算法、参数和 OS 下，两者都按当前采样进行动态检测；前者保留 26 ms: With the same algorithm, parameters and OS, both detect the current sample. The first retains 26 ms of base latency; the second removes it. If Window = 0 ms sounds best, try 0 ms Lookahead, allowing the host to finish delay compensation. For Limiter listening comparisons, see page 39.
多数普通压缩可保持完整 Window。缩短后，局部动态、谐波染色和噼啪声可能变得: Most normal compression can retain the full Window. Shortening it can increase local dynamics, harmonic coloration and crackles. At low values, especially below 10 ms, oversampling is recommended; see page 45. Window avoids pauses caused by changing delay compensation; it still changes the processing sound.
旧工程的 10 ms Lookahead 会迁移为 26 ms；仍可将 Wind: Old 10 ms Lookahead sessions migrate to 26 ms. Set Window to 10 ms to retain that detection length. A 0 ms Lookahead setting does not guarantee zero total latency: OS filters and Limiter Ceiling can still add delay.
输入毫秒 / 连续调整 / 精细调整。: Type milliseconds / continuous adjustment / fine adjustment.
恢复当前 Lookahead 允许的最大值。: Restore the maximum allowed by the current Lookahead.
Window 跟随新的 Lookahead，恢复最大值。: Window follows the new Lookahead and resets to its maximum.
恢复已存 Window，不当作手动切换复位。: Recall saved Window; do not treat recall as a manual reset.
独立选择检测策略；不改变已设定的 Lookahead 延迟。: Choose a detection strategy without changing the selected Lookahead latency.
SAFE 位于右下区域第二排；黄色点亮为 Safe，未点亮为 Normal。新实: SAFE is on the second row at the lower right. Yellow means Safe; unlit means Normal. New instances default to OFF.
先按前两页确定 Lookahead 与 Window，再选择是否开启 SAFE。: First set Lookahead and Window as described on the previous two pages. Window sets detection length; SAFE determines how the past and future peaks within that length are used. They control the range and the choice separately.
带 Delay 或混响的干净吉他、人声等素材，叠加后的电平变化可能让增益快速来回: Clean guitar, vocals or other material containing delay or reverb can cause rapid gain changes as sounds overlap. Range in normal Single mode can also cause crackles on some material. Try SAFE with the full Window, then compare the main sound, echoes and sustain.
未来强音可能在到达前就压低邻近弱音；强音结束后，过去 Window 仍含这个峰值: An upcoming loud event can attenuate nearby quiet audio before it arrives. After it ends, the past Window may still contain its peak and attenuate following quiet audio. Dips may appear on either side of loud events. A shorter Window reduces their duration, but also weakens crackle suppression.
与 Classic / Super 的区别: How SAFE differs from Classic / Super
SAFE 改变检测电平的取法；Classic / Super 决定检测到该电平后: SAFE changes how the detector level is selected. Classic / Super chooses the dynamics curve applied to that level. Pre- and post-attenuation come from the selected Window; no hidden Attack / Release stage is added to the dynamics core.
下一页给出固定参数比较 SAFE、再调整 Window 的试听步骤。: The next page describes comparing SAFE at fixed settings, then adjusting Window.
分别取过去、未来 Window 的峰值，再选较小的一边。通常保留更多局部动态，减: Find the peak in each past/future Window, then use the smaller one. Usually retains more local dynamics and reduces a loud event's influence on nearby quiet audio.
取两边峰值中较大的一边。较长 Window 可使检测更稳定，有助于抑制快速增益变: Use the larger peak. A longer Window stabilizes detection and helps suppress continuous crackles caused by rapid gain changes.
SAFE：噼啪声与提前压的试听步骤: SAFE: listening for crackles and pre-attenuation
优先听同一段带 Delay / 混响的干净素材，再回到完整混音。: Start with the same clean source containing delay / reverb, then return to the full mix.
Lookahead 先选 26 ms，SAFE 关闭、Window 26 ms。: Start at Lookahead 26 ms, SAFE off and Window 26 ms. Fix Ratio, thresholds, Makeup, Mix and Output, and listen for crackles and the main sound's dynamics.
点亮 SAFE，先保留完整 Window: Enable SAFE with the full Window
Safe 取前后较大的峰值，较长 Window 有助于抑制增益快速变化引起的噼啪: Safe uses the larger past/future peak. A longer Window helps suppress crackles caused by rapid gain changes. Compare attacks, sustain and repeated echoes with Normal, not just loudness.
如果强音前后被压低得太明显，缓慢减小 Window，寻找噼啪声控制与提前压之间的: If audio around loud events is attenuated too much, shorten Window gradually to balance crackle control against pre-attenuation. Lookahead and base latency stay unchanged. Alt-click restores the full Window.
在选好的 Window 下比较 1x、4x、8x、16x。较高 OS 可减少混叠: At the selected Window, compare 1x, 4x, 8x and 16x. Higher OS reduces aliasing but does not replace Window selection. Finish with a level-matched A/B comparison and check final output peaks.
普通单压启用 Range 时，有些素材也会出现噼啪声。此时同样可以尝试 SAFE: Range in normal Single mode can also cause crackles on some material. Try SAFE here too, starting with the full Window and shortening it by ear.
Safe 的取舍要一起听: Listen to both sides of the Safe tradeoff
较长 Window 可能在强音到来前就压低弱音，并在强音结束后维持一小段衰减。这: A longer Window can attenuate quiet audio before a loud event arrives and keep attenuating briefly after it ends. This is pre- and post-attenuation, not an added Attack / Release stage. Safe targets this type of rapid gain modulation; it cannot repair clipped input or host dropouts.
没有可见凹陷，也不代表两个 Window 的失真相同：稳态周期内的增益变化可能已: No visible dip does not mean equal distortion at two Window settings: gain may vary differently within steady cycles. Listen to actual audio and examine harmonics and level steps together. The plug-in Display helps explain settings but does not replace these checks.
SAFE 关闭，从完整 Window 开始。: Start with SAFE off and the full Window.
Normal 中逐渐缩短 Window，同时留意噼啪与粗糙感，并开启过采样。: Shorten Window gradually in Normal, listen for crackles and roughness, and enable OS.
SAFE 点亮，先用完整 Window，再按素材缩短。: Enable SAFE with the full Window, then shorten it to suit the source.
减小 Window；保护也随之减弱，Window = 0 ms 时两种检测相同。: Shorten Window; protection also weakens. At Window 0 ms, both detectors are identical.
ST 与 LR：一起处理，或分别处理: ST and LR: together or independently
普通压缩的右下方 Mode 按 ST → MS → LR 循环切换。通常先用 S: In normal compression, Mode at the lower right cycles ST → MS → LR. Start with ST; choose LR for separate channel settings. Limiter replaces this selector with a single ST display and a numeric L/R Link control; see page 32.
LR：上方为 L，下方为 R，各有独立控件。: LR: L above, R below, with independent controls.
选择 L 或 R 可单独监听对应一侧，并居中呈现，便于比较。结束后回到 ALL，: Choose L or R to audition that side centered. Return to ALL to check normal stereo, and do not leave one-sided audition active for the final output.
对立体声使用共同压缩增益，适合作为人声、乐器和总线的起点。: Uses common compression gain for stereo; a useful starting point for tracks and buses.
左右各有独立的 Ratio、阈值、Makeup 和 Mix；DUAL 时每侧各有: Left and right have independent ratios, thresholds, Makeup and Mix; DUAL adds UP / DOWN per channel. Check for stereo image shifts on asymmetric material.
MS / DUAL：上方为 Mid，下方为 Side；每个声道各有 UP / D: MS / DUAL: Mid is above Side. Each channel has its own UP / DOWN Ratios and thresholds.
Mid 主要反映左右共有的内容，Side 反映左右差异。它们并不精确对应“中间一: Mid mainly represents content common to both sides; Side represents their differences. They are not a precise separation of a center track from every other track.
先听 M 与 S 各包含什么: Listen to M and S first
用 MONITOR 的 M / S 检查素材，再回到 ALL。: Use M / S under MONITOR, then return to ALL.
例如需要收住中心动态时，先调 M 的 Ratio / Mix；需要保留环境与宽度: For steadier center dynamics, start with M Ratio / Mix. Treat S cautiously when preserving ambience and width.
M/S 的压缩或音量变化可能改变空间感。回到 ALL 后检查中心、宽度和单声道兼: Compression or level changes in M/S can alter the sense of space. In ALL, check center, width and mono compatibility, not only soloed domains.
声道 LINK：保留差异，一起调整: Channel LINK: adjust together, keep differences
在普通压缩 LR 或 MS 模式下，Mode 旁的 LINK 用于声道之间的同类: In normal LR / MS, LINK beside Mode connects matching controls across channels. Set the channels separately, then enable it to adjust them together without forcing equal values.
SINGLE 示例：Mode 旁的声道 LINK 已开启，左右 Ratio 仍分: SINGLE example: channel LINK beside Mode is on, while the left and right Ratios remain at 3:1 and 5:1.
关闭 LINK，建立两侧关系: Set the relationship with LINK off
先确定哪一侧需要更强的压缩或更少的混合。: Decide which domain needs more compression or a different blend.
拖动任意一侧同类参数，另一侧跟随同样变化量。Dual 中，切换一侧 UP ON: Adjust either channel's control and the other follows by the same amount. In Dual, toggling UP ON synchronizes the other channel's UP ON; DOWN ON works the same way. Upward and downward switches remain independent.
任意一侧将超出范围时，两侧会停在能保留差值的位置。Super 中一侧 Thres: If either side would exceed its range, both stop where the difference can be retained. In Super, one Threshold at -inf cannot form a finite dB offset; set both thresholds to finite values first if you want that relationship.
Ratio 中间的小 LINK 管每个声道内的 Up / Down 反向联动；M: The small LINK between the Ratios links Up / Down within each channel. LINK beside Mode links matching L/R or M/S parameters. With both enabled, channels move together while each channel retains its existing Up / Down relationship. LINK beside Input only controls opposite input/output gain changes; see page 13.
点击右上角 SC: INT / SC: EXT 打开，按钮文字表示当前来源。: Click SC: INT / SC: EXT at the top right. Its label shows the current source.
低频一来整段都被压：用 INT + HPF，见第 27 页。<br/>希望鼓声出:
If bass content compresses everything, try INT + HPF; see page 27.
To make bass duck when the kick arrives, use EXT; see page 28.
EXT 曲线显示经过 HPF 和 Key Gain 后的外部侧链信号。调整 Wi: The EXT curve shows the external key after HPF and Key Gain. Window, SAFE and OS do not change this curve; HPF and Key Gain do. It is time-aligned with the main audio history.
INT 根据当前轨道本身判断；EXT 根据另一条轨道送来的信号控制当前轨道的提升: INT follows the current track itself. EXT uses a signal sent from another track to control boost or attenuation on the current track.
只在 EXT 可用。调整外部 Key 的检测电平，改变触发强度，不直接调主轨道音: Available only with EXT. Adjusts the external detector level and trigger strength, not the main track level.
减少检测信号中的低频；作用于 INT 或 EXT。OFF 为全频，开启后范围 2: Reduces low frequencies in the INT or EXT detector key. OFF is full-band; active range is 20-500 Hz.
查看送到检测器的信号是否有电平。EXT 显示 N/A 时，先检查宿主侧链通道是否: Check that the detector receives a signal. With EXT showing N/A, first check that the host sidechain bus is enabled.
临时听检测信号，帮助检查路由与 HPF；听完关闭，再判断正常输出。: Temporarily audition the detector key to check routing and HPF. Switch it off before judging normal output.
适用场景：处理鼓组、Mix Bus 或母带时，底鼓或贝斯每次出现都会把其他内容明: Use this when kick or bass repeatedly pulls down the rest of a drum bus, mix bus or master. The goal is less low-frequency triggering, not less bass in the audible signal.
听起来“没有切低频”是正常的: It is normal not to hear bass being cut
HPF 只过滤用于判断压缩的 Key，不直接滤波正常输出。它也不是 Key Ga: HPF filters only the key used to decide compression, not normal output. It is not equivalent to Key Gain: Key Gain scales the detector level; HPF changes frequency weighting. Too high a cutoff can make the compressor ignore bass that still needs control.
先用 INT 听清问题: Start with INT and hear the problem
循环一段低频与其他内容同时出现的素材，保持 HPF 为 OFF，建立对比。: Loop a passage with bass and other content together. Leave HPF OFF to establish a comparison.
点击 SC: INT，确认 SOURCE 仍选 INT。Key Gain 此时灰: Click SC: INT and keep SOURCE on INT. A disabled Key Gain is normal here.
从较低截止频率开始，听低频到来时整段是否还被过度压低。一次只改一点。: Start at a low cutoff and listen for less whole-mix ducking on bass events. Make small changes.
打开 SC LISTEN，听 HPF 去掉了哪些低频；随后关闭，回到完整声音。: Use SC LISTEN to hear which bass content HPF removes, then turn it off and return to the full sound.
HPF 拖动期间也会刷新历史；松手后完成最终更新。若显示 HPF UPDATIN: HPF history also refreshes during dragging and finishes after release. If HPF UPDATING appears, wait for it to clear before a precise comparison.
滤波后 GR 可能变少或形状变化。根据目的用 Ratio、Threshold 或: Filtering may reduce GR or change its shape. Revisit Ratio, Threshold or Mix as needed, then compare at similar loudness.
插件插在“要被压低”的贝斯轨道上；底鼓只作为触发来源送入它的侧链。不要把插件插反: Insert the plugin on the bass - the track to turn down. Send the kick to its sidechain as the trigger. Do not reverse the tracks or confuse a normal audio send with a sidechain send.
没有传统 Attack / Release 可调；避让形状会受触发素材、Look: There are no conventional Attack / Release controls. Ducking depends on the trigger material, Lookahead, SAFE, Window and compression settings. It is not necessarily smoother than conventional sidechain compression on every source.
启用贝斯轨上这个插件实例的侧链输入；在底鼓轨道添加指向它的侧链发送，并打开发送。: Enable sidechain input for this plugin instance on the bass. Add and enable a kick send to that sidechain. Names and locations vary by host.
点击 SC 按钮，把 SOURCE 切到 EXT。播放底鼓并检查 KEY LEV: Open SC, choose EXT and play the kick. Check KEY LEVEL first; if it has no reading, fix routing before increasing Ratio.
短暂打开 SC LISTEN，应听到底鼓而不是贝斯。确认后关闭试听。: Briefly enable SC LISTEN: you should hear the kick, not the bass. Turn audition off afterward.
为向下避让，可先用 SINGLE、Ratio 高于 1:1、Range OFF；: For downward ducking, start with SINGLE, Ratio above 1:1 and Range OFF. Set detector strength with Key Gain or the send level, and set the lower boundary with Threshold. Leave HPF OFF initially.
用 Mix 决定让出多少空间: Use Mix to decide how much room to make
先找到清楚的避让，再减小 Mix，保留需要的贝斯持续感。边听两条轨道边调，不只听: Find an audible duck, then reduce Mix to retain the desired bass sustain. Listen to both tracks together, not only solo bass.
提高 HPF 会减少底鼓低频的触发，可能反而减弱你想要的避让。只在需要更偏向敲击: Raising HPF reduces low-frequency kick triggering and may weaken the duck you want. Use it when you want more emphasis on the attack or less unwanted low-bass triggering.
把操作放回真实混音: Apply it in a real mix
人声、吉他、钢琴：稳住动态，保留表达: Vocals, guitar, piano: consistency with articulation
先试 SINGLE / ST / INT 和 26 ms，把 Ratio 调到: Try SINGLE / ST / INT and 26 ms. Raise Ratio above 1:1, then use Mix to keep consonants, plucks or hammer attacks natural. To process only louder parts, raise Threshold and leave Range OFF. Use Match and compare in the mix.
带 Delay / 混响的干净吉他或人声若出现连续噼啪，可开启 SAFE、保持完: If clean guitar or vocals containing delay / reverb produce continuous crackles, enable SAFE with the full Window, then shorten Window gradually and compare; see page 20.
尾音与轻声：让选中的细节靠前: Tails and quiet phrases: bring detail forward
想抬起较轻的字、拨弦尾音或残响时，试单压向上；用 Threshold 排除不想提: To lift quiet syllables, plucked-note tails or ambience, try upward Single compression. Use Threshold to exclude tiny sounds you do not want to lift, and Range to exclude louder parts. To control loud parts too, switch to Dual and adjust Up and Down separately. Use their independent ON / OFF switches to compare; disable Ratio LINK for independent ratio adjustments.
Mix Bus / 母带：追求整体凝聚感: Mix bus / mastering: a more cohesive balance
当你想要整体更稳、更有 Glue，又不希望传统 Attack / Release: When you want a steadier, more cohesive mix without deliberately reshaping drum attacks through conventional Attack / Release, try it as an alternative to G Bus-style compression. Start gently, compare balance across sections and lower Mix when needed.
底鼓一来就压低全曲时，试 INT + HPF；不要为了让 GR 更小而把 HPF: If every kick pulls the whole mix down, try INT + HPF. Do not raise the cutoff merely to make the GR number smaller. At similar loudness, check drum attack, low end, space and the song’s larger dynamic movement.
人声触发伴奏：清出唱词空间: Vocal-keyed accompaniment: make space for words
把插件插在伴奏总线上，将人声送到它的外部侧链，选 EXT。先用 SC LISTE: Insert the plugin on the backing bus, send the vocal to its external sidechain and choose EXT. Confirm the source with SC LISTEN. Select SINGLE, Ratio above 1:1 and Range OFF, then adjust Key Gain, Threshold and Mix so the backing steps back while the vocal plays.
如果爆破音触发过重，试着提高侧链 HPF。如果呼吸或底噪也让伴奏退让，先检查发送: If plosives trigger too much ducking, try raising sidechain HPF. If breaths or noise also make the accompaniment dip, check the sent signal and Threshold; HPF alone will not solve every unwanted trigger.
关闭 SC LISTEN；普通 LR / MS 的 MONITOR 回到 ALL: Turn off SC LISTEN. In normal LR / MS, return MONITOR to ALL. Check that before/after loudness is similar. For final peak control, enable Limiter and set Ceiling; use headphones and Match for level-matched listening, as on pages 33-39.
Limiter L/R Link：控制左右的相互影响: Limiter L/R Link: connect left and right limiting
一张 ST Display、一组参数，保留左右独立限幅的能力。: One ST Display and one set of controls, with independent left/right limiting.
右下第一排为 L/R Link 数值，不再提供 ST / LR / MS 选择或: The first row at the lower right is numeric L/R Link. Limiter has no ST / LR / MS selector or channel Monitor.
L/R Link 同时用于动态处理和最终 Ceiling。上压产生的提升不会仅因: L/R Link applies to dynamics and final Ceiling. Upward gain is not transferred to the other channel merely by linking. Double-click to type a percentage, drag vertically, or hold Shift for fine adjustment. Alt-click resets to 0%.
追求更大响度，建议从 0% 开始。更重视立体声细节与声像稳定时，逐渐调大 L/R: Start at 0% for maximum loudness. Increase L/R Link when stereo detail and image stability matter more. The channels then share more attenuation; this does not restore detail already lost to compression. Compare at similar loudness.
共用参数，不代表共用全部检测结果: Shared settings do not mean identical detection
Ratio、Makeup、Mix 及阈值只显示一组，左右使用同样的设置。Dual: Ratio, Makeup, Mix and thresholds have one shared set of controls. Both channels use these settings. Dual UP / DOWN ratios remain independent, with no Ratio LINK. LINK beside Output still connects the downward threshold, Makeup and output compensation; it is separate from the audio linking amount here.
原 ST 设置迁移后采用 100% L/R Link；原 LR / MS 采用: Old ST settings migrate to 100% L/R Link; old LR / MS to 0%. Saved thresholds are retained and old Range no longer processes Limiter audio. Values already changed to -45 dB by an earlier version cannot be reconstructed automatically. The former L set (M in MS) supplies shared controls; old MS becomes left/right processing. Sessions with unequal channel settings may sound different: check and listen. Normal LR / MS retains its previous behavior.
左右各自检测并控制自己的衰减；一侧的强音不会仅因链接而压低另一侧。: Each channel detects and controls its own attenuation. A loud event on one side does not attenuate the other merely through linking.
逐渐增加左右衰减的相互影响，用听感选择独立动态与声像稳定之间的平衡。: Gradually increase shared attenuation; choose the balance between independent dynamics and stereo stability by ear.
把两侧中较强的衰减应用到两侧，减少左右增益变化不一致造成的声像移动。: Apply the stronger attenuation to both channels to reduce image movement caused by different gain changes.
Limiter 常规用法：下压、关联与 Window: Limiter workflow: downward compression, link and Window
先建立下压，再平衡响度、动态与立体声细节。: Set downward compression first, then balance loudness, dynamics and stereo detail.
单张 ST 图、共用参数；Scale 可选 -30 / -60 / -90 dB: One ST display and shared controls. Scale selects -30 / -60 / -90 dB and the fader scale follows. Limiter has no Range.
Ratio 先用 20:1 或以上，最高 1000:1；Mix 100%，设置: Begin with Ratio at 20:1 or more, up to 1000:1, and Mix at 100%. Set Ceiling and TP; keep LINK beside Output enabled. Lower Threshold gradually: Output compensates by the same number of dB in the opposite direction.
用 L/R Link 选择左右关联量: Choose the stereo relationship with L/R Link
追求更大响度，建议从默认 0% 开始，让左右独立限幅。更重视立体声细节与声像稳定: For greater loudness, start at the default 0% for independent limiting. Increase it for greater stereo detail and image stability. More attenuation is shared, which can also affect loudness.
用 Window 寻找响度与动态的平衡: Balance loudness and dynamics with Window
普通压缩多数情况下可保持完整 Window；Limiter 中它对响度与动态尤其: Normal compression can usually retain a full Window. In Limiter, Window is especially important for loudness and dynamics. Keep Lookahead fixed and shorten Window gradually. At low values, especially below 10 ms, use oversampling.
Window 为 0 最好时，再试 0 ms Lookahead: If Window 0 sounds best, try 0 ms Lookahead
在其他参数和 OS 一致时，两者都使用 Window = 0 ms 检测。先在原: With other parameters and OS equal, both use Window = 0 ms detection. Choose the sound at the existing latency first, then select 0 ms to reduce base latency. Allow the host to update compensation when changing Lookahead; see page 39.
L/R Link 决定左右衰减的相互影响；Output LINK 负责下压阈值、: L/R Link controls shared left/right attenuation. Output LINK connects the downward threshold, Makeup and output compensation. After these adjustments, consider adding a little UP, then compare at matched loudness with headphones, Match and Bypass.
Limiter 双压：下压调好，再补少量上压: Limiter Dual: add gentle upward compression
双压是常规下压之后的补偿用法。: Use Dual to add compensation after setting the standard downward compression.
示例：DOWN 保持 100:1，UP 为 1:1.2；Output LINK: Example: DOWN remains 100:1, UP is 1:1.2 and Output LINK is on. Up and Down ratios are independent; there is no Ratio LINK.
先完成上一页的下压: Complete the previous page's downward setup
先用 20:1 至 1000:1 的 Ratio、Threshold 与 Out: Use a Ratio of 20:1-1000:1, Threshold and Output LINK to set the desired Limiter compression. Note the algorithm and Ratio.
切换 DUAL，保留原来的下压设置: Switch to DUAL and retain the downward setup
Single 的 Threshold 会延续到 DOWN 阈值。DOWN RAT: Single Threshold carries over to the DOWN threshold. DOWN RATIO and Single Ratio are stored separately: check the DOWN algorithm and Ratio, and set them to your Single values if needed to retain the compression you established.
保留 Output LINK。Limiter 已取消 Ratio LINK，调整: Keep Output LINK enabled. Limiter has no Ratio LINK, so adjusting UP does not change the DOWN ratio. Enable UP and move gently from 1:1 toward 1:1.2; this small range is often enough. Use the UP threshold to choose the audio to lift.
UP 阈值独立于 Output Gain 和 Makeup；保留 Output: UP Threshold is independent of Output Gain and Makeup, even with Output LINK on. Scale offers -30 / -60 / -90 dB in both modes. UP cannot exceed DOWN; changing Scale does not rewrite thresholds.
特别留意底鼓与军鼓的延音: Listen closely to kick and snare sustain
补上压后，底鼓和军鼓的延音可能被抬高，听起来更突出。不要只听起音与响度，也要听鼓: Upward compression can raise kick and snare tails, making them more prominent. Listen beyond attacks and loudness: check whether sustain fills the spaces between hits or makes the rhythm feel sluggish.
双压效果不好时，优先尝试分段压缩: If Dual does not work well, try segmented compression
双压在已调好的下压基础上，用少量上压补充细节，DOWN RATIO 保留原来的下: Use gentle upward compression to add detail to the established downward setup. Keep the original DOWN RATIO, then fine-tune if needed. If adding UP does not improve the result, reduce or disable it and try segmented compression to control dynamics; this can work better. Decide whether to use Mix after settling these choices.
Ceiling 与 TP：选择最终上限: Ceiling and TP: choose the final limit
Output 下方的 Ceiling、恢复方式与 TP。TP 开启时显示 dBT: Ceiling, recovery and TP sit below Output. The unit is dBTP with TP enabled.
TP 开启时保留少量重建余量，读数不必恰好贴线。Hard Clip 的恢复与失真: TP retains a small reconstruction margin, so readings need not sit exactly on the line. Hard Clip has different recovery and distortion behavior. With TP off, inter-sample peaks can still exceed the dBFS ceiling; check the actual TP reading.
双击 Ceiling 数值输入；上下拖动调整，Shift 精调，Alt 单击恢复: Double-click Ceiling to type a value; drag vertically, hold Shift for fine adjustment, or Alt-click to reset to 0. Undo and redo are supported. Recovery mode affects TP only; see page 46.
总 OS 选 1x 时，音频保持原采样率，TP 仍使用独立的重建峰值检测；不会暗: At overall OS 1x, audio stays at its native rate while TP uses a separate reconstruction detector. It does not silently switch all audio to 8x. Final peak protection and latency still follow the active path; see page 45.
-24 至 0 dB，默认 0；设置最终峰值保护的参考上限。: -24 to 0 dB; default 0. Sets the reference upper limit for final peak protection.
通过重建峰值检测与增益恢复控制真峰值。总 OS 的四个倍率均可使用。: Controls true peaks with reconstruction detection and gain recovery. All four overall OS rates are available.
使用 Hard Clip；1x 在原采样率削波，4x / 8x / 16x 在对: Hard Clip: native-rate clipping at 1x, or clipping at the selected 4x / 8x / 16x audio rate.
压缩与 Ceiling 共用同一音频倍率；不再单独设置 Ceiling OS。: Dynamics and Ceiling share one audio rate; there is no separate Ceiling OS setting.
TP 读数：看实际输出，保留峰值: TP meter: measure output and hold peaks
右侧 TP L/R 读数，监测最终左右立体声的真峰值。: The TP L/R readout measures true peaks in the final left/right stereo output.
TP 表读取实际输出，包含 Makeup、Mix、Output Gain、Cei: The TP meter reads actual output, including Makeup, Mix, Output Gain, Ceiling and headphone 1:1 compensation. It does not simply display the Ceiling setting, or clamp its reading to that setting.
峰值读数会保留约 20 秒；出现新的更高峰值时更新并重新计时。Hold 按音频播: The peak reading holds for about 20 seconds. A new higher peak updates the value and restarts the timer. Hold advances with audio playback time.
鼠标双击 TP 读数即可立即归零，再播放检查片段。无需等待旧峰值自动消退。: Double-click the TP readout to clear it immediately, then play the passage again. There is no need to wait for the previous held peak to expire.
保留的旧峰值可能来自修改前的设置。先清零，再判断当前上限是否符合预期。: A held peak may come from earlier settings. Clear it before deciding whether the current limit behaves as expected.
关闭 TP 后读数高于 Ceiling: TP exceeds Ceiling with TP off
TP 表仍测量真峰值；采样峰值保护不保证采样间峰值同样受限。: The meter still measures true peaks. Sample-peak protection does not also guarantee the intersample peak limit.
监听补偿已计入读数，请结合 MON 换算上限判断。: The readout includes listening compensation. Judge it against the converted MON limit.
普通 MS 的单域表与 TP 不同: Normal MS domain meters differ from TP
TP 看最终 L/R；单独的 M/S 电平与左右输出上限不是同一个量。: TP measures final L/R. Individual M/S levels and left/right output limits are different quantities.
Output Gain 左侧的小耳机，只在 Limiter 模式显示。: The small headphone button left of Output Gain appears only in Limiter.
耳机点亮后，Output 的数值和联动保留；下方出现 MON 监听上限。: With headphones on, Output values and links stay active. MON shows the listening limit below.
打开耳机，声音仍完整经过动态处理和 Ceiling，然后再抵消可见 Output: With headphones on, audio still passes through the complete dynamics and Ceiling stages. The visible Output Gain is then cancelled. Limiting's dynamic and waveform changes remain; only the listening level is adjusted for comparison.
Output 可以继续调整；下压阈值、Makeup 与 Output 的联动仍然: Output remains adjustable. Links between the downward threshold, Makeup and Output remain active; the Dual UP threshold stays independent. The headphone function cancels only Output's direct level change, so changes to dynamics remain audible. Switch it off to restore normal Output Gain.
Ceiling 也换到同一监听标准: Ceiling follows the same listening reference
例如 Ceiling = -1 dB、Output = +6 dB，耳机开启时对: For example, Ceiling = -1 dB and Output = +6 dB give a listening limit of -7 dB with headphones on. The Ceiling setting stays at -1 dB. Switching headphones off restores the normal output reference. TP measures the actual output.
耳机开关默认关闭，随工程保存，独立于 A/B。切换 A/B 时可以一直保持同一监: Headphones default to off, are saved with the project, and remain independent of A/B. Keep the same listening mode while comparing A/B. Headphone and Bypass switches use smooth transitions; headphones add no separate audio delay.
1:1 不会自动等响: 1:1 does not automatically mean equal loudness
耳机只抵消 Output Gain，并不自动弥补压缩、Ceiling 或 Inp: Headphones cancel Output Gain; they do not automatically compensate all loudness changes from compression, Ceiling or Input. Use Match for a level-matched comparison. The next page gives the full procedure.
在已经调好的 Limiter 上比较: Compare after setting up the Limiter
先完成第 33 页的下压，或第 34 页的双压补偿，再打开耳机。保持当前 Cei: Set downward compression as on page 33, or Dual compensation as on page 34, then enable headphones. Keep Ceiling and TP fixed, and turn off SC LISTEN. Limiter always outputs full stereo.
先开启耳机，再开始播放，等待有效测量建立。播放中可以点击 Match；需要只统计: Enable headphones before starting playback, then wait for valid measurements. You can click Match during playback. To measure only new settings, stop and restart playback.
耳机模式比较原始输入与真正经过 Ceiling、耳机补偿后的输出。按实际左右处理: Headphone mode compares the original input with the actual output after Ceiling and headphone compensation. Actual left/right results determine one shared compensation amount, written to the single Makeup control. Dry/wet mixing is included.
用插件 Bypass 比较原声: Compare the original with plugin Bypass
Bypass 返回延迟对齐的原始输入，不经过限幅或耳机音量补偿。听起音、尾音、密: Bypass returns delay-aligned original input without limiting or headphone gain compensation. Listen for attack, tails, density and groove; trim Makeup if needed.
结束试听，恢复正常输出: Finish listening and restore normal output
关闭耳机，保留调好的参数。重新检查 TP 和 Ceiling，再判断送往后级的最: Switch headphones off and keep the adjusted settings. Check TP and Ceiling again before judging the final signal sent downstream.
Match 做一次补偿，不持续追着音量跑: Match applies one correction, not continuous gain riding
再次点击仍从本次播放开始累计，不清空、不重复叠加补偿。若只想比较调整后的设置，可: Further clicks still use everything since this playback started, without clearing data or stacking compensation. To compare revised settings alone, stop and replay before Match. Compensation can be limited when Limiter LINK is off, controls reach their limits, or Mix is fully dry.
分别给 A、B 播放相同的素材，再 Match。耳机状态独立于 A/B，Limi: Play the same material for A and B, then Match each. Headphone state is independent of A/B; Limiter / TP / Ceiling, rates and recovery are recalled with A/B. Keep Lookahead and rates alike where possible to reduce latency changes.
Limiter：用 Window 比较，再选择 0 ms: Limiter: compare Window, then choose 0 ms
Window 改变检测范围，Lookahead 决定基础延迟。: Window changes detection length; Lookahead sets base latency.
先固定 Lookahead，连续比较不同 Window: Keep Lookahead fixed while comparing Window
调好下压和 L/R Link 后，先保持 Lookahead 26 ms，让 W: After setting downward compression and L/R Link, retain Lookahead 26 ms and shorten Window from 26 ms. Reported latency stays unchanged, avoiding pauses from compensation changes while you compare loudness, attacks, tails and contrasts between sections.
SAFE 关闭时，较短 Window 会增加局部动态与染色，也更容易产生粗糙感或: With SAFE off, shorter Window increases local dynamics and coloration, but may also add roughness or crackles. With SAFE on, it reduces attenuation around loud events while weakening protection. Most normal compression needs little adjustment; Limiter rewards careful comparison.
可以把 Lookahead 也切到 0 ms。在其他参数与 OS 相同、延迟对齐: You can also select Lookahead 0 ms. With other parameters and OS equal, delay aligned and switching transitions excluded, both use the same sample-by-sample, zero-Window detection. The original setting retains Lookahead latency; 0 ms removes that part. Do not subtract two unaligned renders.
Limiter 的 0 ms 设置可用于追求更大响度，同时保留段落之间的对比。结: Limiter at 0 ms can increase loudness while retaining contrasts between sections. Results depend on the material, algorithm and amount. Listen to both choruses and quiet sections, rather than judging loudness alone. With Window 0, SAFE and Normal detect identically.
配合过采样与 TP 恢复: Use oversampling and compare TP recovery
Window 较低，尤其低于 10 ms，以及使用 Limiter Ceilin: At low Window values, especially below 10 ms, and when using Limiter Ceiling, compare 4x / 8x / 16x. Oversampling reduces aliasing, not all harmonics. With TP on, compare TIGHT, AUTO and SMOOTH recovery; see page 46.
Lookahead 数字不等于插件总延迟: Lookahead is not the total plug-in latency
Ceiling 另有两级约 3 ms 的预读及重建检测对齐，OS 滤波也可能增加: Ceiling adds two approximately 3 ms lookahead stages plus reconstruction alignment. OS filters can also add latency. Normal mode does not carry Ceiling's extra delay, so toggling Limiter may make the host adjust compensation even at the same Lookahead. Window adjustments do not cause this latency switch.
Range 不低于 Threshold；DOWN 不低于 UP。相撞时一起移动，: Range cannot be below Threshold; DOWN cannot be below UP. Faders move together when they meet; coincident thresholds stop dynamic processing. New Limiter instances use Single Threshold / Dual DOWN at 0 dB, Ratio 1:1, and UP at the minimum of its selected algorithm. Saved thresholds are retained when Scale is reduced.
Super 的阈值数值最低为 -119.99 dB，再往下为 -inf（Sing: Super's lowest numeric threshold is -119.99 dB; below that is -inf (the Single lower bound may show OFF). Scale defaults to -90 dB and offers -30 / -60 / -90 dB. Values outside the view are retained. Range = 0 dB stops compression at 0 dB; OFF disables this Range behavior.
Single 一组；Dual 的 UP / DOWN 可分别选择。: One choice in Single; separate UP / DOWN choices in Dual.
Limiter 切换时保留下压阈值衔接，见第 44 页。: Limiter switching preserves downward-threshold continuity; see page 44.
1:1 为默认 / 重置值；Limiter 常规使用 20:1 至 1000:1: Default / reset: 1:1. Standard Limiter use: 20:1 to 1000:1.
默认 1:1；Limiter 补上压通常先在 1:1 至 1:1.2 间尝试。: Default 1:1. Start gentle Limiter upward compensation between 1:1 and 1:1.2.
默认 1:1；切入 Limiter 双压后，核对已调好的下压比例。: Default 1:1. Check the established downward Ratio when entering Limiter Dual.
默认均 ON；独立试听并保留 Ratio。: Both ON by default; audition independently while retaining Ratios.
Classic -90 至 0；Super -inf 至 0 dB: Classic: -90 to 0 dB; Super: -inf to 0 dB
普通与 Limiter 相同；可见刻度随 Scale。: Same in Normal and Limiter; visible scale follows Scale.
普通 Single 中，达到或超过它就不压缩；OFF 关闭这项作用。Limite: Normal Single: no compression at or above Range. OFF disables this rule. Not used in Limiter.
可见刻度随 Scale；DOWN 不低于 UP。: Visible scale follows Scale; DOWN cannot be below UP.
反向联动 UP / DOWN；首次 ON。Limiter 无此联动。: Link UP / DOWN ratios inversely; initially ON. Not available in Limiter.
普通：ST / MS / LR；OFF / ON: Normal: ST / MS / LR; OFF / ON
Limiter 改为 L/R Link 0-100%，见第 32 页。: Limiter uses L/R Link 0-100%; see page 32.
参数速查：音量、监听与侧链: Quick reference: gain, monitoring and SC
普通模式与 Limiter 的音量、检测与时间设置分别保留，见第 44 页。EC: Normal compression and Limiter retain separate level, detection and timing settings; see page 44. ECO stop/hidden-editor behavior and FULL near-silence sleep are covered on pages 48-49.
分别保存各自的输入设置。: Each mode retains its own input setting.
耳机抵消 Limiter Output 的直接监听增益。: Headphones cancel the direct monitoring gain from Limiter Output.
普通模式的等量反向增益联动。: Equal-and-opposite gain linking in normal mode.
ALL / L / R 或 M / S: ALL / L / R or M / S
仅普通 LR / MS 可用；Limiter 无声道监听。: Normal LR / MS only; no channel monitoring in Limiter.
初始 26 ms；手动切换后恢复完整 Window。: Initially 26 ms; manual changes reset to a full Window.
默认 / Alt 为最大值；固定延迟调整检测长度。: Default / Alt: maximum. Adjust detection length at fixed latency.
选择检测策略；0 ms Lookahead 时禁用。: Choose detector strategy; disabled at 0 ms Lookahead.
所有 Lookahead 生效；默认 1x。: Active at every Lookahead setting; default 1x.
KEY GAIN 只在 EXT 可调。: KEY GAIN is adjustable only in EXT.
只滤检测信号；试听在关闭面板或编辑器时结束。: Filters detection only. Listening ends when the panel or editor closes.
TP 关闭时使用 Hard Clip。: Uses Hard Clip when TP is off.
默认 0 dB；使用总 OS，TP 在 1x 也可开启。: Default 0 dB. Uses overall OS; TP is also available at 1x.
默认 AUTO；TP 关闭时不作用。: Default AUTO; inactive with TP off.
MON = Ceiling - Output；工程保存，独立于 A/B。: MON = Ceiling - Output; saved in projects, independent of A/B.
新实例沿用上次手动选择: New instances recall the last manual choice
每个实例独立；工程保存，独立于 A/B。: Per instance; saved in projects, independent of A/B.
选择 DUAL，关闭 DOWN 旁的开关；普通压缩还需关闭 Ratio LINK: Select DUAL and turn DOWN off. In normal compression, also disable Ratio LINK. Keep Mix at 100% and all gains at 0 dB; choose a suitable Lookahead.
确保素材在两个阈值之间: Place the signal between the thresholds
例如 UP 为 -50 dB、DOWN 为 -20 dB，确认一段轻声的检测电平: For example, set UP to -50 dB and DOWN to -20 dB. Check that the detector level of a quiet passage lies mainly between them. With Ratio still at 1:1, there is no boost yet.
将 Up Ratio 依次调向 1:2、1:4、1:8，同时听音，观察 Boos: Move Up Ratio through 1:2, 1:4 and 1:8 while listening and watching Boost / Mix and positive dynamic gain. Once confirmed, enable DOWN to add attenuation and compare overall loudness again.
确认对应 Ratio 低于 1:1，Mix 大于 0，Bypass 关闭；Dua: Check that the relevant Ratio is below 1:1, Mix is above 0 and Bypass is off. In Dual, the relevant upward/downward switch must be ON.
检测电平要高于 UP、低于 DOWN。UP 以下原样输出，高于 DOWN 时只做: The detector must be above UP and below DOWN. Below UP, the original level is retained; above DOWN, only downward processing applies.
Threshold 与 Range（Dual 中为 UP 与 DOWN）是否重合: Do Threshold and Range (UP and DOWN in Dual) coincide? This stops all dynamic processing. Separate them and compare.
较响的部分突然不再处理: Loud parts suddenly stop being processed
普通 SINGLE 是否启用了 Range？达到或超过它就不压缩；希望较响的部分: Is Range enabled in normal SINGLE? Compression stops at or above it. Set Range to OFF to keep processing louder audio.
普通压缩的 Ratio LINK 首次默认开启；需独立调整时关闭。Limiter: Normal Ratio LINK is initially enabled; disable it for independent adjustment. Limiter ratios are always independent.
另一侧可能已达到最小值或最大值；联动会共同停止。反向调整即可继续。: The other control may have reached a limit, stopping both. Reverse the adjustment to continue.
看着主轨道电平却不按预期触发: Main track level does not explain triggering
检查 SOURCE 是否为 EXT，或 HPF 是否改变了检测信号。阈值判断依据: Check whether SOURCE is EXT or HPF is changing the detector signal. Threshold decisions follow the detector signal.
Classic 压缩后，为什么有时低于阈值？: Why can Classic output fall below the threshold?
阈值约束的是检测电平上的增益曲线，不是最终输出的最低线。一个 Window 内比: Threshold constrains the gain curve at the detector level, not a minimum final output level.
